prompts.first_draft:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: native SNES fighting-game stage background, wide 8:7 composition.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and composition guide: preserve a wide courtyard scene with an open readable fighting plane; Image 2 is supporting style only for bold cartoon contour weight and cel-color discipline, not a character insert; Image 3 is an architectural reference only for the white two-story party house, central covered patio, balcony and broader right wing/rooflines.

Primary request: Transform the existing Castillo courtyard stage into an original, distinctly cartoon 1990s arcade-fighting-game background with playful, exaggerated but recognizable shapes. Make the house a bright ivory and coral/orange two-story home with a black iron balcony and a central covered patio; make the right wing visibly broader with stepped rooflines, borrowing the actual photo's courtyard proportions. Add a lush rounded garden, cool teal grass, slate paving and a clear blue sky with chunky pink clouds. Place a small group of expressive cartoon coworkers cheering near the patio behind the fighting plane; tiny simplified silhouettes/figures only, no individual likenesses. Add red cups and a party table near the patio. Hang warm string bulbs as nice ambient targets around the patio/garden.

Style/medium: hand-inked flat cel-shaded cartoon background, strong deep-navy contours, broad bold shapes, no photorealism. Keep only 2–3 flat shade bands per material, crisp graphic edges, lively arcade illustration, visually cohesive with the attached fighter atlas' navy outlines and saturated colors while keeping every background person fully original and tiny.

Composition/framing: wide side-on stage background; reserve a quiet HUD band across y=0..39; keep a continuous empty ground/fighting plane across y=168..223 with feet landing around y=201; place all people, party furniture and garden detail above/behind the plane; no foreground props blocking fighters; broad house fills midground but preserve playable empty space.

Lighting/mood: sunny, cheerful house-party afternoon with warm string-bulb accents; readable at 256×224 and at native 8:7.
Color palette: bright ivory, coral and orange house; deep navy outlines; cool teal grass; slate paving; clear blue sky; chunky pink clouds; warm yellow bulbs; small red cups.
Materials/textures: solid graphic fills, limited flat cel bands, minimal tiny texture marks only where they aid readability.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: change the scene into cartoon art; keep the original stage's broad courtyard readability and horizontal fighting-plane logic; original distinct artwork; no logos or UI; no foreground fighters; no recognizable real people; no use of commercial game sprites.
Avoid: photorealistic granules, dithering, bloom, noise, painterly blur, 3D rendering, detailed floor reflections, realistic faces, detailed text, watermarks, Capcom or Street Fighter logos, recognizable copyrighted characters, dramatic perspective that narrows the fighting plane.
